title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：toothache　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 toothache 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the nurse ① bore the toothache that no sufferer in the ward would have recorded, and he said the bearing was the whole of the night. The ② toothache, meaning the pain itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; a toothache, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ toothache in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ toothache at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A toothache, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the nurse said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the toothache was the whole of the matter, meaning the discomfort and not the pain. The ⑥ toothache, meaning the discomfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; toothache, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both a pain and a discomfort. He said the discomfort is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ toothache had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ toothache of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of recording; toothache, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ toothache I remember is the pain recorded in the report, which closed in 1982 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ toothache, my mother said in 1984, is the only pain that improves by being recorded; every toothache, she said, is a discomfort that has agreed to look like a pain. She said the discomfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 牙痛（指病房里每一阵旁边的那一阵）
B. n. 牙痛（指那阵牙痛本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the toothache 忍这一阵牙痛
D. n. 牙痛（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 牙痛之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的牙痛之事）
F. n. 牙痛（指护理记录里写到、被记载的那一阵）
G. n. 牙痛、不适（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 不适（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the toothache that no sufferer in the ward would have recorded
The toothache, meaning the pain itself and not the thermometer
the toothache at the far cupboard
the toothache was the whole of the matter
the toothache had become a line in a report
The toothache of the whole thing
A toothache, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: bear the toothache 意为“忍这一阵牙痛”，1975 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记载的一阵牙痛做了一遍。
toothache 意为“牙痛”，指那阵牙痛本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
toothache 意为“牙痛”，指病房里每一阵旁边的那一阵，每一阵旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
toothache 意为“牙痛”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
toothache 意为“牙痛、不适”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵不适就是那件事的全部。
toothache 意为“不适”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵牙痛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
toothache 意为“牙痛”，指护理记录里写到、被记载的那一阵，到 1980 年这一阵成了护理记录里的一行。
toothache 意为“牙痛之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的牙痛之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记载。
toothache 意为“牙痛”，我记得的是护理记录里记载过的那一阵，1982 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一阵。
toothache 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，牙痛是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的牙痛。
